dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your Chainvoice dashboard. Send, request, import and track blockchain invoices from one place.

createInvoice.title: Send Invoice
createInvoice.description: Create an invoice and send it on-chain to any wallet address, payable in the token of your choice.

batchInvoice.title: Send Multiple Invoices
batchInvoice.description: Create and send several on-chain invoices in a single transaction.

sentInvoices.title: Sent Invoices
sentInvoices.description: Track the invoices you have sent, see which ones are paid and cancel those that are still pending.

requestInvoice.title: Request Invoices
requestInvoice.description: Create a shareable link that lets someone send you an invoice pre-filled with your details.

receivedInvoices.title: Received Invoices
receivedInvoices.description: Review the invoices sent to your wallet and pay them securely on the blockchain.

importInvoice.title: Import Invoice
importInvoice.description: Import an invoice shared with you by link, QR code or file.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your sender details and product catalog for new invoices.

features.title: Features
features.description: Explore what Chainvoice offers: on-chain invoices, multi-token payments and full invoice tracking.

about.title: About
about.description: Learn why Stability Nexus built Chainvoice, a decentralized platform for creating and paying invoices on the blockchain.

working.title: How It Works
working.description: See how a Chainvoice invoice moves from creation to on-chain payment.

treasury.title: Treasury
treasury.description: Manage Chainvoice platform fees and treasury configuration.
